name: Vermont
overview: Vermont provides an income-sensitive homeowner property-tax credit and a refundable renter credit using county and family-size benchmarks.

programs.name: Property Tax Credit
programs.incomeDefinition: 2025 household income on HI-144, covering taxable and specified nontaxable income of household members.
programs.incomeLimits: Up to $115,400 for 2025 income used in the 2026 claim.
programs.formulaSummary: Income-sensitive education and municipal credits using eligible housesite taxes, household income, property value and local tax parameters.
programs.application: File HS-122 and HI-144 with Homestead Declaration, generally by April 15, 2026.
eligibilityNotes: Domiciled in Vermont all of 2025, not another person's dependent.
Own and occupy declared homestead on April 1, 2026.
programs.programYear: 2025 income and 2025/26 housesite taxes; credit applied to 2026/27 property-tax bill.

sources.title: HS-122 instructions: 2026 claim based on 2025 income

programs.name: Renter Credit
programs.incomeDefinition: Claimant/family program income; special rules for shared housing and subsidies.
programs.incomeLimits: Published county- and family-size-specific limits; verify the 2025 schedule.
programs.formulaSummary: Up to 10% of HUD fair market rent for county and family size, with income phaseout, month proration, and shared-housing/subsidy adjustments.
programs.application: File RCC-146 through myVTax, income-tax software, or paper; final 2025 claim deadline October 15, 2026.
eligibilityNotes: Full-year Vermont domicile; at least six months renting.
Not claimed as another taxpayer's dependent.
Landlord must submit certificate; claimant does not need to obtain it.

sources.title: 2025 Renter Credit calculator and credit amounts

laterChanges: A one-year renter increase applies to claims filed in 2027, not the 2025 rent comparison.
Owner credit cap changes for claims filed beginning in 2028 are tracked separately.
researchNotes: Owner credit and renter credit use different timing; the owner claim based on 2025 income is formally a 2026 property-tax credit.
Current renter webpage describes 65% county-median eligibility; the exact 2025 income-limit file needs validation before calculation.
